title: Herbal Pilaf Delight
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make pilaf dish infused with herbal notes. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: jelly
ingredients.notes: omitted for a lighter version, or try a sugar-free jelly

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the dehydrated onion and cook until rehydrated, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the herbal tea, glassy rice, and pilaf. Stir well to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
